ESPN stands out to the U.S. sports-viewing public as a trusted brand with a storied history. Over the course of three decades, ESPN became a presence in the living rooms of 100 million people. However, viewership has been impacted by broader industry trends, such as the massive expansion of digital entertainment. Streaming has forever changed how the public consumes content, siphoning viewers from traditional brands. In 2021, ESPN was present in 79 million households, and the company continues to find ways to expand its viewership by evolving its entertainment product.
